entities.summary: Dovydas Neverauskas is a Lithuanian professional baseball player who is a pitcher and is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Pittsburgh Pirates, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hiroshima Toyo Carp. He was the first player from Lithuania in MLB, NPB, and LMB history.
